scripts.test:core: cd core && zig build test -Doptimize=debug --summary all
scripts.test:core:safe: cd core && zig build test -Doptimize=safe --summary all
scripts.check:gltf: cd core && zig build && node scripts/validate-gltf.mjs
scripts.check:3mf: cd core && zig build && python3 scripts/validate-3mf.py
scripts.check:drawings: cd core && zig build && python3 scripts/validate-drawings.py
scripts.check:examples: cd core && zig build && ./zig-out/bin/kupcad fmt --check src/frontend/fuzz_corpus/canonical && ./zig-out/bin/kupcad check --max-warnings 0 src/frontend/fuzz_corpus
scripts.test:wasm: cd core && zig build test-wasm -Dtarget=wasm32-wasi -Doptimize=debug --summary all
scripts.test:wasm:safe: cd core && zig build test-wasm -Dtarget=wasm32-wasi -Doptimize=safe --summary all
scripts.test:wasm:threads: cd core && zig build test-wasm -Dtarget=wasm32-wasi -Doptimize=debug -Dwasm_threads=true --summary all
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm -r check
scripts.dev:vscode: pnpm build:core:native && pnpm --filter @kupcad/vscode build && code --extensionDevelopmentPath="$PWD/packages/kupcad-vscode" examples
scripts.dev:playground: pnpm build:core:wasm && pnpm --filter @kupcad/wasm build && pnpm --filter @kupcad/playground dev
scripts.dev:app: pnpm build:core:native && pnpm --filter @kupcad/app sidecar && pnpm --filter @kupcad/app tauri dev -- -- "$PWD/examples"
